text:
Maya: Hey team — Lightbridge asked for a short-lived API token for their POC. They want to test rate-limited hosted endpoints and do some load tests tomorrow. Can SE + security approve a 48h token?

Jonas: +1 from SE. 48h is fine for load testing but suggest scoping to only text.generate and embeddings for safety. Also recommend IP allowlist if they run tests from fixed IPs.

Priya: Security note: we prefer shortest possible TTL. 48h okay if they use ephemeral with audit logs and we enable rotation after initial run. Need to confirm they accept audit retention and that data ingestion policy covers PII.

Anna (Lightbridge): We can do 48h. Tests will come from two GCP VMs: 34.82.12.99 and 34.82.12.100. We need a simple handoff and quick rotation instructions.

Maya: Great — ops: can we create a scoped, expiring token that:
- limited scopes: text.generate, embeddings.create
- expires in 48 hours
- IP restricted to those two IPs
- audit logs enabled and shared with Lightbridge afterwards

Jonas: I'll create the token in the console and paste a one-time secret in the thread. Once they confirm receipt we'll rotate and revoke.

Priya: Also set token label to: lightbridge-demo-03-2026 and add notes pointing to the security questionnaire id #LB-23.

deploy-bot: new-key-created: id=sk-live-xxxxxx (one-time visible). Created by Jonas in project/lightbridge-demo. Expires 2026-03-23T18:30:00Z.

Jonas: Sharing the one-time secret (COPY ONCE):

```
sk-live-0a9f3b2c-ephemeral
```

Jonas: Instructions:
1) Use header: Authorization: Bearer sk-live-0a9f3b2c-ephemeral
2) Keys are scoped; embeddings and generation only.
3) IP allowlist applied, ensure requests originate from the two GCP IPs.

Anna (Lightbridge): Got it, received the secret and tested a quick call, works. Thanks!

Maya: Awesome. Follow-up actions:
- Jonas to enable rotation policy to auto-rotate any active demo tokens after expiry.
- Priya to confirm audit log export path and S3 bucket access for Lightbridge security team.
- Maya to document in the deal tracker the token id and expiry.

Priya: Confirmed: audit logs will be exported to an internal bucket (redwood-audit-exports/clients/lightbridge) and we'll generate a signed URL for a 7-day window after test completion. Need legal sign-off for sharing logs; Maya, can you get that ok from the AE?

Maya: I'll get legal sign-off. Quick note — if they want KMS-wrapped keys or private deployment later, we should flag as a potential upsell.

Jonas: Re: rotation/revocation — if Lightbridge wants us to revoke before TTL, we can do:
```
# revocation via admin CLI
redwood keys revoke sk-live-0a9f3b2c-ephemeral --project lightbridge-demo
```
Will run that on request.

Anna (Lightbridge): If we finish early we'll ask you to revoke. Also can you add a short how-to on rotation for our engineers?

Jonas: Pasted a short how-to:
- Generate new token in Console -> Keys -> Create -> set scopes and expiry
- Replace Authorization header in test harness
- Call revoke on old key or wait for TTL
- For CI, use env-var injection and avoid checking tokens into repo

Priya: Security checklist satisfied for this demo: scoped token, IP restriction, audit logs, label/notes present. Legal sign-off pending for log sharing.

Maya: Thanks all — I'll ping when legal confirms. Anna, reach out here if you need us to revoke early. :thumbsup:

Anna (Lightbridge): Will do. Appreciate the quick turnaround!

Maya: Closing note for deal tracker: created ephemeral scoped token for Lightbridge POC, id=sk-live-0a9f3b2c-ephemeral, expires 2026-03-23T18:30:00Z, IPs allowed [34.82.12.99, 34.82.12.100], audit logs export pending legal.
